# Portrait test fixture

`astronaut.jpg` is a JPEG conversion of scikit-image's `astronaut.png` (Eileen Collins, NASA).
Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.19.3/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Scikit-image documents this NASA image as public domain:
https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.19.x/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Used only for automated, on-device face-landmark/rendering tests, not product endorsements.
